Flashbots is a research and development organization focused on mitigating maximal extractable value (MEV) on public blockchains. Flashbots builds open-source infrastructure for transaction ordering on Ethereum. Flashbots operates without intermediaries in the sense that its tools interact directly with the public Ethereum network.

Blend is an NFT lending protocol deployed on Ethereum. Blend is built as smart contracts on a public blockchain. Blend allows users to borrow funds against NFTs used as collateral.
